interludes.speaker: bot
interludes.text: The new greenhouse wing is thriving! Harvest now, or wait 4 {Ds} for full-size crops?
interludes.fact: Plants recycle air too: they take in CO₂ and release oxygen.

interludes.speaker: sci
interludes.text: There's more ice deeper down. A permanent drill takes 3 {Ds} to install.
interludes.fact: Using local materials is called ISRU: In-Situ Resource Utilization.

interludes.speaker: psy
interludes.text: The new colonists are homesick. Schedule extra video calls home?

fact.moon: From the Moon, video calls home have barely a second of delay.
fact.mars: From Mars, "calls" are recorded messages. Replies take many minutes.
